name: Luma gradient social card by lu.ma
description: A 1200×630 social card built almost entirely from atmosphere: a heavily blurred mesh gradient where hot pink dominates the centre, coral-orange pools in the lower right, a sky-blue patch enters at the top-left corner and luminous white breaks glow through the upper right. The only focal element is a white lowercase wordmark, slightly left of true centre, closed by a small four-point sparkle that acts as the brand's punctuation mark. With no headline, CTA or imagery, hierarchy is achieved purely through white-on-saturated-pastel contrast, which keeps the card legible even when shrunk to a small link preview.
